description: The single best next task for your role, with the reasons it was chosen. Your own claimed work comes first, then priority (tasks in active milestones first within a priority), dependencies and unblock impact. Never returns tasks assigned to a person or claimed by another agent; without a role you only get tasks with no owner role. Also returns `recoverable` (tasks another agent started and no longer claims: check with them before taking one over with inventor_update_task) and `waiting_on_cancelled` (tasks held back by a cancelled prerequisite). Read-only: nothing is claimed until you start a task.

role.description: Override your role (backend, frontend, art, qa…)

name: inventor_next_task
